headline_finding: The dispatch premise is wrong in the project's favour and wrong in a way that explains the defect. The project DOES hold Morrowind interface references: corpus/70-visual/refs/morrowind/REF-A12b/ has 33 Steam captures acquired 2026-08-06 - dialogue x5, journal x3, inventory x4, map x5, character_sheet x4, barter x3, book_reader x4, tooltip x2, level_up x2, char_creation x1 - all manifested, eye-verified, vanilla_confidence: high, with reference_for listing RI-UIX03 and RI-UIX06. What is missing is not the pixels. It is that RI-VIS09 (the register of what pixels we hold) never mentions REF-A12b, its SS2 routing table still gives RI-UIX* only the OpenMW XML and explicitly forbids citing it for appearance, and REF-A12/README.md still ends 'one 1024x768 vanilla screenshot each ... is the only thing that would' close the appearance gap. A UI builder who obeyed the register was TOLD the reference did not exist. That is the gap to close.
